newsitem.title: USA: Schering uses Pharmacopeia drug library.
newsitem.headline: Schering uses Pharmacopeia drug library.

text.p: Pharmacopeia Inc said on Monday Schering-Plough Corp gave the company an undisclosed cash payment to begin work on a lead compound identified from a Pharmacopeia discovery library.
Using proprietary tagging technology -- Encoded Combinatorial Libraries on Polymeric Support -- Pharmacopeia generates large libraries of labelled small molecules.
The company said Schering-Plough extended its agreement with Pharmacopeia for another year. The program focused on drug discovery in cancer and asthma therapy, it said.
Pharmacopeia would also provide more combinatorial libraries of novel compounds for Schering-Plough to evaluate, it said.
